interventions.detail: Installed Ollama via official install.sh (README only links ollama.com)
apt install zstd, which the Ollama installer needs to extract its .tar.zst bundle
No systemd in container: start 'ollama serve' manually with nohup before 'ollama pull'
Created a uv venv at /work/venv (Python 3.12) for pip install -e .
